adapter_policy: The editing of parts laid one after another on one flat timeline (moved out of qnc-script, user 2026-10-31): edges of a part (Ctrl+I/O, right click, drag, arrows, wheel) with the trim zoom, A1 of a part (channel, level, off), the pause and join before a part, a part moved or removed. It plays a draft through the one Broadcast Player and gives every change back as a PieceWrite; its owner (the script, the S-Story skeleton) writes it. It reads and writes no database.
